description: Use only once the user has seen and agreed to the exact text of a reply stored with draft_review_reply or draft_discord_reply. Posts it publicly, under the business's own account, as the business's reply to that review or Discord message: pass the draftId, confirm: true and the confirmationToken returned with the draft (single use, ten minutes; an expired one means drafting again). Never confirm on the user's behalf. Each review or message takes one posted reply, and a repeat returns the reply already posted. It writes to a third-party platform and cannot be undone from here. No cost to call.

confirm.description: true only once the user has agreed to the exact text.

confirmationToken.description: The token returned with the draft.

draftId.description: The draft id from draft_review_reply or draft_discord_reply.

name: post_drafted_reply

alreadyPosted.description: true when this draft had already been posted; nothing was posted twice.

title: Post Drafted Reply
